_comment: Hand-entered games. These are merged on top of data/sports-scraped.json and WIN on conflict.
Use this when the scraper misses a PDF, gets a row wrong, or a game is rescheduled.
Identity for de-duplication is: sport + level + gender + date + opponent.
Fields: sport (slug), sportLabel, level, gender, season, date (YYYY-MM-DD),
time ('HH:MM' 24-hour, or null for TBA), opponent, homeAway ('Home'|'Away'|''),
